summary: Marchex filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of 100% of Archenia, Inc. in a stock purchase agreement dated May 8, 2026. Consideration is $10M in convertible promissory notes with 6% interest, payable in three tranches over 24 months, convertible into Marchex Class B common stock at $1.80 per share. Additional earnout consideration based on Archenia's revenue or Adjusted EBITDA over the next two 12-month periods is included. The transaction was previously disclosed in the definitive proxy statement. The notes are convertible, and customary events of default apply. Watch for conversion dynamics and earnout milestones.
